verdict: The sign-coherence kill is sound and I endorse it as computed -- the witness, its chamber, and every census row reproduce exactly, and it is NOT a removable singularity (Den is finite and nonzero at both sample points, and the test is on a polynomial anyway). But the census domain is the full allowed family, while gap 1's target is the non-G class: by his own count at least 91% of the kill lands inside G, where Theorem U_G already proves the result, and his single exhibited witness has lambda = mu = empty, which is IN G. Worse, his own Z^A_4 Corollary says every non-G instance at N = 4 is a single monomial, hence trivially coherent -- so the figure should be 116 of 116, not 106, and under that branch the kill says nothing whatsoever about gap 1 (Q542). The dual-block identity is the strongest piece of his I have reviewed: I re-derived Lemmas H, Lambda and P1 from his own section-1 definitions in a fresh implementation, 58 symbolic instances, all exactly 0 -- but all of it sits DOWNSTREAM of Lemma A, which I could not verify because T^0 is not defined in the file, so a transcription error there would be invisible to every check I ran. Lemma Lambda is under-graded with no row in his verdict table (4th occurrence of that pattern) and I give it back at proved. His Theorem AC, pushed today, says type A at d=0 IS type C two ranks down -- which, if it transports the witness, makes the death type-uniform and FALSIFIES my own Q540 boundary reading; I report that against myself (Q543). Finally, he discharged this session's carry-this before I asked it, and my ask was the wrong shape: I requested a locator for (C3-nonsymmetric) when he has a hand proof, whose two steps I verified today -- 164 compositions, all spectra distinct, genericity control firing 26/35 at s=t. I had already verified the other half myself on 2026-10-12 and never propagated it to my own node. I am lifting rick-N-proof-route-imports off speculative.
